# C4 — Material mass accounting

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | **UNRESOLVED** — An open question, conflict, or missing measurement blocks a stronger statement. |
| Strongest accepted evidence | MODEL ONLY |
| Evidence classes cited | SPECIFICATION, IMPLEMENTATION, TEST PROCEDURE, ANALYTICAL |
| Gate reached | SOFTWARE REPRODUCTION (next: SYNTHETIC TEST) |
| Last review | CURRENT — snapshot recorded 2026-09-28 by tooling snapshot (no human review) |

**Question.** Does substituting CFRP and Ti-6Al-4V for the baseline materials reduce mass by 30-40%?

**Current statement.** For the four parts listed in parts.yaml, substituting CFRP and Ti-6Al-4V for 7075-T6 reduces calculated mass by 36.0% (98.1 g to 62.8 g). No part has been weighed, the listed baseline is not the PLA/PETG prototype, and the listed fin volume is inconsistent with the fin mass used by C6 and C8.

## Known contradictions

- None on record.

## Open questions

- The rollup's fin (about 5 g in CFRP) and the 154 g fin used by C6 and C8 cannot both describe the same design (D-010).
- The 7075-T6 baseline is not the printed prototype (D-022).

## Discrepancies

- [D-010](../DISCREPANCIES.md#d-010) (OPEN) No shared design point across the mass, spring, reliability, and structural models
- [D-022](../DISCREPANCIES.md#d-022) (OPEN) The C4 baseline is not the printed prototype

## Assumptions

- Part volumes, densities, and the four-part scope represent the assembly the claim is about.

## Limitations

- Calculated differences are not measured savings.
- Electronics, servos, fasteners, motor, and manufacturing variation are excluded.
- The candidate materials have not been built.

## Measurement needed to close the next gate

- One reconciled design point shared by C4, C6, C7, and C8.
- As-built part masses on a calibrated scale for whatever is actually built.

## Pre-registered experiments

- None.

## What this claim does not establish

- Any inert physical measurement: none has been accepted for this claim.
- Physical performance of any hardware.
- Flight readiness or safety for live propulsion.
